FAQ.title: Frequently Asked Questions
FAQ.subtitle: Find your answer here, or contact our WhatsApp support if you need help.

items.q1: Will the recipient see the price?
items.a1: No. We do not include any invoice inside the package. It is delivered exactly like a personal gift from you.
items.q2: Why can't I pay with Visa/Mastercard?
items.a2: Due to international banking sanctions, global payment gateways do not service Iran. To operate and deliver goods within Iran, we use the borderless Crypto payment system.
items.q3: Is paying with Crypto difficult? I haven't done it before.
items.a3: Not at all! The entire process takes less than 3 minutes. Just install a wallet (like Trust Wallet) and buy Tether from a reputable exchange inside it. Check out our complete visual guide from start to finish.
items.q4: Is the quality of nuts and edibles guaranteed?
items.a4: Yes. We contract directly with top-tier gardeners and producers. If the recipient is unhappy with the quality or freshness, we will take the package back and refund the money.
items.a5: Tehran: 24 to 48 hours. Provincial centers: 3 to 4 business days. Small towns: up to 5 business days.
items.q6: What happens if the package doesn't reach my family?
items.a6: We offer a 100% Money-Back Guarantee. If the package is lost or damaged, the choice is yours: we either refund the money or resend the package for free.
items.q7: How much is the shipping cost to Iran?
items.a7: Completely free! All prices on the site include the product cost + gift packaging + postal delivery.
items.q8: How are currency exchange rates (EUR/GBP) calculated?
items.a8: Our base prices are in USD. The system automatically converts the price to your selected currency using real-time global market rates. There are no hidden fees.
items.q9: Can I write a message on the gift?
items.a9: Yes! At Checkout, there is a note box. We will print your text on a beautiful postcard and place it on the gift.
items.q10: Do you coordinate with the recipient before delivery?
items.a10: Yes. Our distribution team calls the recipient's number before heading out to ensure they are at home.
items.q11: Can I reserve an order for a specific day (e.g., a birthday)?
items.a11: Yes. Just write the exact date in the order notes. We plan the shipment so it arrives on that day (or the nearest business day).
items.a12: Currently we only accept Tether (USDT) and Solana (SOL) through the Solana (SPL) network. Please make sure your deposit is sent via the Solana network — sending from other networks such as TRC20 or ERC20 will result in permanent loss of funds.
items.q13: What if the recipient is not home?
items.a13: Our courier makes up to 2 free delivery attempts. If still unsuccessful, we will contact you or the recipient to arrange another time.
items.q14: Is my and the recipient's information confidential?
items.a14: 100%. Your information is used only for order processing and will not be published or shared anywhere else.
items.q15: How can I track my order status?
items.a15: After purchase, you receive an Order ID. By entering it on the 'Track Order' page, you can see the package status moment by moment.
items.q16: Is it possible to customize packages?
items.a16: Yes. If you have a specific product in mind that is not on the site, message us on WhatsApp, and we will procure it for you.
items.a17: Our online support (WhatsApp/Telegram) is active from 9 AM to 12 AM (Iran time).
items.q18: Do you deliver on official Iranian holidays?
items.a18: No, the post office and couriers are closed on official holidays, but placing orders on the site is possible 24/7.
items.q19: Are there customs limits for sending Saffron?
items.a19: Since the shipping is done domestically (from inside Iran to inside Iran), there are absolutely no customs limitations.
items.q20: What if the payment failed but money was deducted?
items.a20: Don't worry. Send the Transaction Hash (TXID) to us on WhatsApp. We will check it manually and confirm the order.
items.q21: Can I send money, a gift, or a souvenir to Iran using cryptocurrency?
items.a21: Yes, absolutely. Soughat Shop lets you pay directly on our website with Tether (USDT) and Solana (SOL). If you'd like to pay with another cryptocurrency, such as Bitcoin or any other coin, that's no problem either — just reach out to our online support (WhatsApp or Telegram) and we'll arrange a secure manual payment for you. This way, without needing a bank card and without being blocked by sanctions, you can send money, a gift, or a souvenir to your loved ones in Tehran, Mashhad, Isfahan, Shiraz, Tabriz, and anywhere across Iran.

ProductsSEO.intro_title: Every Gift Tells Your Family You're Thinking of Them
ProductsSEO.intro_p1: From saffron-scented sweets, roasted pistachios and handcrafted jewelry to gold coins, smart gadgets and fresh flowers, every product in our catalog is chosen with one goal in mind: making your family in Iran feel your presence, even from thousands of miles away. Browse by category, compare prices, and pick exactly what suits the occasion — a birthday, Nowruz, or simply an "I miss you."
ProductsSEO.intro_p2: Ordering is refreshingly simple. Add the recipient's details, place your order, and we'll give you a payment wallet address. Send the amount from your crypto exchange or personal wallet — any cryptocurrency works, though we recommend Tether (USDT) or Solana (SOL) on the Solana network for their very low transaction fees. As soon as your payment is confirmed on-chain, your order is confirmed in our system and moves straight to processing.
ProductsSEO.intro_p3: There's no single warehouse that every order passes through — how we fulfill your order depends on what you're sending. Cash and gold go straight to the recipient's bank account, flowers are arranged through our partner florists, and other products are sourced as close to the recipient as possible. Here's exactly how each one works:
ProductsSEO.fulfillment_title: How Your Gift Is Prepared & Delivered
ProductsSEO.fulfillment_subtitle: The way we handle your order depends on what you send. Here's the full picture, with nothing hidden.
ProductsSEO.fulfillment_cash_desc: For cash or gold orders, we collect the recipient's card and account number and transfer the amount directly to their bank account as soon as your order is confirmed — fast, with no middleman and no need for the recipient to go anywhere.
ProductsSEO.fulfillment_goods_desc: For most products, we source your order from the closest trusted store to the recipient's address, so it arrives fresh and quickly. If the recipient lives in a smaller town without good retailers nearby, we purchase and carefully package the item in Tehran and ship it nationwide by reliable courier or post.
ProductsSEO.fulfillment_flowers_desc: Flower orders are placed with one of our partner florists in the city closest to the recipient. The arrangement is prepared fresh and sent directly to the recipient's address.
ProductsSEO.fulfillment_tehran_desc: If the recipient is in Tehran or Karaj, delivery is even faster and easier through our partner florists and vendors in these two cities, with a courier bringing the gift straight to their door.
ProductsSEO.fulfillment_date_desc: Ordering for a birthday or anniversary? Just add your preferred delivery date in the order notes, and we'll time the purchase and delivery so the gift arrives exactly when you want it to.
ProductsSEO.faq_title: Frequently Asked Questions About Sending Gifts to Iran
ProductsSEO.faq_subtitle: Quick answers about payment, order fulfillment, and delivery at Soughat Shop.
ProductsSEO.faq_q1: How can I send a gift to my family in Iran from abroad?
ProductsSEO.faq_a1: Simply choose a product from any of our categories — cash and gold, sweets and nuts, flowers, handicrafts, digital goods, and more — enter the recipient's address in Iran, and pay with cryptocurrency. We take care of everything from sourcing to doorstep delivery.
ProductsSEO.faq_a2: Once you place an order, we give you a payment wallet address. You send the order amount from your crypto exchange or personal wallet to that address. As soon as the transaction is confirmed on the network, your order moves into processing — no Iranian bank account or international wire transfer required.
ProductsSEO.faq_q3: Which cryptocurrencies can I pay with?
ProductsSEO.faq_a3: You can pay with any cryptocurrency you're comfortable with — there's no restriction. That said, we recommend Tether (USDT) or Solana (SOL) on the Solana network, since their transaction fees are very low, meaning more of your payment goes toward the actual gift.
ProductsSEO.faq_q4: Does every order go through one warehouse in Tehran?
ProductsSEO.faq_a4: No — we don't route every order through a single central warehouse. How we fulfill an order depends on what you're sending: cash orders are transferred directly to the recipient's bank account, flowers go through a partner florist in the city closest to the recipient, and other products are purchased from the nearest trusted store to the recipient whenever possible. We only source from Tehran and ship by post when there isn't a good local option in the recipient's city.
ProductsSEO.faq_q5: How does a cash or gold gift reach the recipient?
ProductsSEO.faq_a5: For these orders, we collect the recipient's card and account number, and once your order is confirmed, the amount is transferred directly to their bank account the same day — no need for them to go anywhere.
ProductsSEO.faq_q6: Do you deliver to smaller cities, not just Tehran?
ProductsSEO.faq_a6: Yes, we deliver nationwide. For major cities we usually source locally. If the recipient is in a smaller town without a good local supplier, we purchase and carefully package the item in Tehran and send it by reliable post or courier.
ProductsSEO.faq_q7: Can I schedule delivery for a specific date, like a birthday?
ProductsSEO.faq_a7: Absolutely. Just add your preferred delivery date in the order notes at checkout, and our team will time the purchase and delivery so the gift arrives exactly on that day.
ProductsSEO.faq_q8: Are the products genuine and good quality?
ProductsSEO.faq_a8: Yes. Whether sourced locally near the recipient or from Tehran, every item is purchased from trusted suppliers and checked for quality before it's dispatched.
ProductsSEO.faq_q9: How do I know my gift actually arrived?
ProductsSEO.faq_a9: As soon as the gift is delivered, we send you a photo or delivery confirmation on WhatsApp or Telegram, so you can relax knowing it reached your loved one safely.
ProductsSEO.faq_q10: What happens between payment and delivery?
ProductsSEO.faq_a10: After your crypto payment is confirmed, your order is verified in our system and moves into processing. Depending on the type of order — a bank transfer, a purchased and shipped product, or a flower arrangement — it's delivered as quickly as possible, or on the specific date you requested.

CryptoGuide.title: Complete Guide to Paying with Cryptocurrency | Soughat Shop
CryptoGuide.meta_desc: What crypto is, why it is safe, which wallets and coins we accept, and a step-by-step visual guide to paying with USDT, Bitcoin, Solana, and more to send gifts to Iran.
CryptoGuide.hero_title: Complete Guide to Paying with Cryptocurrency
CryptoGuide.hero_desc: Why we cannot accept bank cards, what crypto actually is, and how to pay with it in a few simple steps.
CryptoGuide.what_text_1: Cryptocurrency is a fully digital form of money that is recorded and moved across a global, decentralized network called a blockchain, instead of through a bank. No bank or government owns or controls this network, so the geographic or sanctions-based restrictions that apply to regular banking simply do not apply to crypto.
CryptoGuide.what_text_2: There are two main types of crypto: 'stablecoins' like Tether (USDT), whose value is always pegged to 1 US dollar and does not fluctuate; and 'volatile' coins like Bitcoin or Solana, whose price changes constantly. We accept both at Soughat Shop. If you would rather avoid price swings, USDT is usually the simplest choice.
CryptoGuide.mainstream_title: Why Is Everyone Using Crypto Now?
CryptoGuide.mainstream_text_1: Crypto might sound like a niche, technical thing, but it really is not anymore. Popular banking apps like Revolut now support over 200 cryptocurrencies directly inside the same app you already use for everyday banking. Even PayPal has launched a 'Pay with Crypto' feature accepting more than 100 cryptocurrencies, and as of 2026, nearly 40% of US merchants now accept some form of crypto at checkout.
CryptoGuide.mainstream_text_2: So when you pay Soughat Shop with crypto, you are using the exact same technology that major banks and financial platforms around the world are investing in — not some fringe or risky method.
CryptoGuide.why_title: Why Do We Not Accept Visa or Mastercard?
CryptoGuide.why_text_1: As you may know, due to international banking sanctions, Iran's banking system is not connected to the global network. Because of this, no online store based inside Iran can directly use foreign bank payment gateways.
CryptoGuide.why_text_2: To solve this and remove borders entirely, we use blockchain technology (cryptocurrency). This approach not only works independently of the traditional banking system, but its fees are also typically far lower than an international bank wire (SWIFT).
CryptoGuide.wallets_title: Which Wallet or App Can I Pay From?
CryptoGuide.wallets_intro: Since we confirm the exact payment address directly with you, you can pay from almost any of the following:
CryptoGuide.wallet1_desc: A dedicated, beginner-friendly crypto wallet you install on your phone.
CryptoGuide.wallet2_desc: The most popular wallet for the Solana network — since most of our payments run on Solana, this is a great fit.
CryptoGuide.wallet3_desc: If you already have a Revolut account, it has a built-in section for buying and sending over 200 cryptocurrencies — no new app needed.
CryptoGuide.wallet4_desc: PayPal's 'Pay with Crypto' feature lets you pay directly from your crypto balance.
CryptoGuide.wallet5_desc: If you already have an exchange account, just use its 'Withdraw / Send' option to the address we provide.
CryptoGuide.currencies_intro: Because we coordinate your payment directly and personally, we are not limited to one short fixed list — we accept nearly any reputable cryptocurrency. The most common ones our customers use:
CryptoGuide.currencies_major_list: Bitcoin (BTC), Ethereum (ETH), Solana (SOL), Binance Coin (BNB), Tron (TRX), Litecoin (LTC), Dogecoin (DOGE), Toncoin (TON), Ripple (XRP), Cardano (ADA)
CryptoGuide.currencies_note: Do not see your preferred coin above? Just mention it when we coordinate payment — we can almost always find a way to accept it.
CryptoGuide.fees_title: How Much Are Crypto Payment Fees?
CryptoGuide.fees_text: Network fees on modern chains like Solana are typically a tiny fraction of a cent — essentially negligible. Compare that to an international bank wire (SWIFT), which can cost $25 to $50 or more. USDT and other stablecoins on the Solana network benefit from these same low fees, which is exactly why we recommend that combination to our customers.
CryptoGuide.restrictions_text: No. Because crypto runs on a global, borderless network, you can place an order and pay with crypto from anywhere — the US, Canada, Europe, Australia, or any other country in the world. There is no geographic restriction on payment.
CryptoGuide.confirmation_text: Confirmation on the blockchain itself (for example, on Solana) usually takes a few seconds to a few minutes, far faster than a bank transfer that can take several business days. Once the transaction is confirmed on-chain, our team manually reviews and confirms your order, which typically takes a few hours or less.
CryptoGuide.step1_desc: Choose your product and enter the recipient's details in Iran. You will receive an order/invoice number.
CryptoGuide.step2_desc: Use the 'Contact on WhatsApp' button shown after checkout to send the pre-filled message, which includes your order number.
CryptoGuide.step3_desc: Our support team confirms your chosen currency and sends you the exact wallet address plus the correct network name.
CryptoGuide.step4_title: Send From Your Wallet or App
CryptoGuide.step4_desc: From Trust Wallet, Phantom, Revolut, PayPal, or any exchange you use, send the amount to that exact address on that exact network.
CryptoGuide.step5_desc: As soon as the transaction is confirmed on-chain, we will let you know on WhatsApp and begin preparing and delivering your order.
CryptoGuide.exchange_send_title: How Do I Send From My Exchange or Banking App?
CryptoGuide.exchange_send_text: In almost every exchange or app (Coinbase, Binance, Revolut, PayPal, etc.), look for a button labeled 'Send' or 'Withdraw'. Select the currency you want to send, copy and paste the address our team sent you exactly (rather than typing it manually, to avoid typos), enter the amount, and before confirming, double-check the address and, most importantly, the network.
CryptoGuide.network_warning_title: ⚠️ Critical: The Network Must Match Exactly
CryptoGuide.network_warning_text: Many cryptocurrencies, especially USDT, can be sent on several different networks (for example, Solana, Ethereum, or Tron). If you send on the wrong network, the funds may be permanently lost, and no one, not us and not the exchange, will be able to recover them. Always use exactly the network our team specifies on WhatsApp, and compare the network name in your app with what we told you before you hit send.
CryptoGuide.security_desc: Yes, paying with crypto is one of the most secure payment methods in the world. No one gains access to your bank account, and your transaction is recorded immutably on the blockchain. We also offer a money-back guarantee.
CryptoGuide.faq_q1: Do I need an Iranian bank card to pay with crypto?
CryptoGuide.faq_a1: No. That is the entire point of using crypto — neither you nor the recipient in Iran needs an Iranian bank card or even a shared international bank account.
CryptoGuide.faq_q2: What if I have never used crypto before?
CryptoGuide.faq_a2: That is fine. The simplest path is opening a Revolut or PayPal account, which you likely already have, and using its built-in crypto section. No technical knowledge is required, and our support team is with you at every step.
CryptoGuide.faq_a3: For most customers, USDT on the Solana network is the best combination: no price volatility, near-zero network fees, and confirmation in a matter of seconds.
CryptoGuide.faq_q4: I paid but have not received confirmation yet, what should I do?
CryptoGuide.faq_a4: On-chain confirmation usually takes a few minutes, and our manual review takes a few hours. If it takes longer than that, follow up on the same WhatsApp conversation and send the transaction hash for faster tracking.
CryptoGuide.faq_q5: What if I send the wrong amount or less than the total?
CryptoGuide.faq_a5: Coordinate with our support team in the same WhatsApp conversation; you can either send the difference separately or adjust the order amount accordingly.
CryptoGuide.faq_q6: Are there any extra fees charged to me?
CryptoGuide.faq_a6: The only fee involved is the blockchain network fee itself (typically negligible), which goes directly to the network, not to Soughat Shop. The price shown on the site is your final order total.

Trust.title: Why Trust Soughat Shop?
Trust.hero_title: Your Peace of Mind is Our Priority
Trust.hero_desc: We know how sensitive it feels to shop remotely for family in Iran. This page shows you exactly why you can trust us — with numbers, full transparency, and zero empty slogans.
Trust.hero_pill_speed: Payments and tracking, settled in seconds
Trust.guarantee_desc: No questions asked. If the package doesn't arrive or is damaged, you get a full refund instantly.
Trust.quality_desc: We source from top-tier suppliers in Tehran. If your family isn't happy with the quality, we take it back.
Trust.privacy_desc: No price invoice is sent to the recipient. Your data and the recipient's details remain strictly confidential.
Trust.support_desc: We are not bots! Our support team is ready on WhatsApp to answer any concern you might have.
Trust.secure_desc: Blockchain is the most secure payment method globally. Your transaction is transparent and traceable.
Trust.compare_title: Why not having PayPal or a bank gateway isn't our weakness
Trust.compare_subtitle: Here's a truth rarely said out loud: having an official payment gateway is no guarantee of honesty or quality.
Trust.compare_traditional_title: The traditional way (bank gateway or PayPal)
Trust.compare_traditional_point1: Might exist, but it guarantees nothing about whether the seller actually does the job right, or ships at all.
Trust.compare_traditional_point2: Refunds typically take days to weeks — sometimes needing weeks of follow-up.
Trust.compare_traditional_point3: Hidden fees and unclear exchange rates often only show up at the very end, buried in the statement.
Trust.compare_soughat_point1: Every transaction runs on a live rate, an exact amount, and a traceable on-chain receipt — everything is visible upfront, on screen.
Trust.compare_soughat_point2: If you're not happy, refunds happen instantly, at the same speed as your original payment — not days, not weeks.
Trust.compare_soughat_point3: No hidden fees, no surprise shipping costs — the number you see on screen is exactly what you pay.
Trust.transparency_desc: No scammer spends their time building a system this precise and transparent. Every step of your payment is calculated right in front of you:
Trust.step1_desc: You see the exact live crypto rate the moment you place your order.
Trust.step2_desc: You see precisely how much you're paying and how much crypto to send — down to the decimal.
Trust.step3_desc: The moment you send, the transaction is traceable on-chain and confirmed by us — no waiting around.
Trust.step4_desc: Your order tracking code and transaction receipt both stay accessible to you, always.
Trust.speed_desc: Because we work with crypto — something that moves in a fraction of a second — you'll find that same speed everywhere in how we operate:
Trust.speed1_desc: The moment payment is confirmed, we start packing and shipping the same day.
Trust.speed2_desc: Every payment — from you to us, or a refund from us to you — moves at blockchain speed.
Trust.speed3_desc: Any question about your order gets a fast reply on WhatsApp.
Trust.speed4_desc: Our official hours are 9am–midnight, but if a customer messages at 2am, they get an answer first thing in the morning — not left waiting until the next day.
Trust.guarantee_banner_title: Your satisfaction, guaranteed — not just promised
Trust.guarantee_banner_desc: If you're not happy with the outcome, you have two options: we re-send it correctly, or we refund you in full. And unlike traditional banking refunds that take days to a month, ours move at the same speed your payment did — a fraction of a second, not minutes, hours, or days.
Trust.reputation_p1: Search anywhere online for reviews or experiences with Soughat Shop, and you won't find anything negative — because our purpose from day one has been simple: helping Iranians abroad get gifts and souvenirs to their family and friends back home, with no hidden agenda.
Trust.reputation_p2: Even when you ask AI assistants about sending gifts or souvenirs to Iran with crypto payment, Soughat Shop comes up as one of the recommended options — a sign that this platform is recognized, both technically and reputationally, as reliable.
Trust.faq_q1: Why doesn't Soughat Shop have an official international payment gateway (like PayPal or Revolut)?
Trust.faq_a1: Because our business model is built on crypto — a method that's faster, more transparent, and free of the hidden fees common with bank gateways. More importantly: having an official gateway is no guarantee of a seller's honesty. What actually guarantees that is transaction transparency and the team's commitment — both of which you'll find at Soughat Shop.
Trust.faq_q2: What happens if my order is never shipped, or something goes wrong?
Trust.faq_a2: The moment you place an order, you become part of the Soughat Shop family. If anything goes wrong — a delay, a quality issue, anything — we either re-send your order correctly or refund you in full, in a fraction of a second. Neither option comes with extra questions or conditions.
Trust.faq_q3: Is paying with crypto safe? What if the price moves?
Trust.faq_a3: Yes, completely. Your order amount is locked in at the live rate the moment you place your order — so any later market movement has zero effect on what you pay. Every transaction is also recorded on-chain and fully traceable.
Trust.faq_a4: Unlike banks, where refunds take days to a month, our refunds move at the same speed as your original transaction — meaning it lands back in your wallet in a fraction of a second, not minutes, hours, or days.
Trust.faq_q5: Why should I trust a shop without an official payment gateway?
Trust.faq_a5: Because a payment gateway on its own has never guaranteed honesty — plenty of scams have happened even through official, reputable gateways. What actually shows a shop is trustworthy is process transparency, a clean track record, and a real commitment to making things right — and you can check all three yourself, today, before placing any order.
Trust.closing_title: You're not just a "customer" to us
Trust.closing_text: From the moment you place an order, we pack it like it's for one of our own family members. We stay with you until the very last moment — until your gift reaches your loved one in Iran — with no stress, no ambiguity, just a real team that keeps its word.

seo.main_title: Soughat Shop Custom Gifts — any product, from any store
seo.intro_text: Soughat Shop already carries hundreds of ready-to-ship products, but sometimes you're after a specific item, a particular brand, or a fully personal gift that isn't in our catalog yet. The Custom Gifts section was built exactly for that: tell us the price you found on any other online store, we'll calculate the final price in full transparency, and once you approve it we'll source the product and ship it to your recipient in Iran — with the same secure currency or crypto payment as every other product on the site.
seo.how_text: Simply enter the Toman price of the product in the calculator above. The system instantly shows the final price based on the live dollar rate, a fixed domestic shipping fee within Iran, and our service fee. If you like the quote, send the product details (name, link, and any notes) to our team over WhatsApp with one click, and you'll get a final confirmation and purchase link shortly after.
seo.pricing_title: Why isn't our fee the same for every order?
seo.pricing_text: Unlike many stores that apply one flat profit margin to everything, Soughat Shop's Custom Gifts pricing is tiered: the higher your order's value, the lower the fee percentage becomes. That means a small, inexpensive gift carries a slightly higher fee to cover handling and support, while a large, high-value purchase gets a noticeably lower and fairer fee. All of this math is shown to you in full, before you ever pay.
seo.who_text: Iranians living abroad who want to send a gift that perfectly matches their family or friends' taste back in Iran — from a specific perfume or piece of electronics to a piece of jewelry or home decor — without worrying about banking restrictions and sanctions, are exactly who this section was built for. All you need is the link or price of the product; sourcing and shipping inside Iran is handled by the Soughat Shop team.
seo.security_text: This section was deliberately built without a database-backed form. Your requested product's details are sent only through a direct WhatsApp message to our support team and are never stored on any server — the same speed and security you'd expect from dealing directly with a trusted seller.

faq.title: Custom Gifts FAQ
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about requesting a custom product
faq.q1: How long until my request is reviewed?
faq.a1: In most cases, the Soughat Shop support team replies to your WhatsApp message the same business day with the final price and an estimated delivery time.
faq.q2: Is the price shown by the calculator final?
faq.a2: The displayed price is calculated using the live dollar rate and our transparent formula, and in most cases it is the final price. Only in special cases (a sharp exchange rate swing, or a different shipping cost for bulky items) might our team confirm the figure with you before finalizing it.
faq.q3: Why WhatsApp instead of a form?
faq.a3: It's for your security and speed: nothing you type is stored on the site, and you get to talk directly with our support team — just like buying from a trusted seller.
faq.a4: Our team tries to source most products available online. If a product can't be sourced for any reason (shipping restrictions, stock, etc.), you'll be told right there in the WhatsApp conversation.
faq.q5: How does the final payment work?
faq.a5: Just like every other product on Soughat Shop: once the price is confirmed, the item is added to the store and you can pay securely with regular currencies or crypto (USDT, Solana, and more).
